name: project-templates-decisions
body: Project-templates decisions [with user]: (1) no fallback — binary ships no templates/themes/fonts/logos/media; missing `templates/` = error. (2) Asset scope: templates, themes, fonts, logos and any media type (e.g. video), type-agnostic. (3) Git-based sharing (push/pull) is FUTURE/out of scope; forward compatibility is secured by global.constraint.template-library-shareable. (4) `templates/` validated fail-fast before deck validation/render/serve. (5) [with user, reconciliation] Layout is `library.yaml`, `slides/<name>/`, `sections/<name>/`, `themes/<name>/`, `media/`; kind by directory, no `usage:` key (presence = error); names unique across slides and sections. (6) [with user] Layouts are standard Go html/template only with pre-rendered safe-HTML content and a minimal central helper set (v1: `media`) — see template-language. (7) [with user] All EY templates/theme/fonts/logos are deleted from the repo; reveal.js and the deck/error/gallery page shells are core (confirming the earlier assumption) and unbranded. (8) [with user] An unbranded demo project `examples/demo/` is the integration/e2e fixture, distinct from the `hello` seed. [autonomous] design choices: template schema moves from Go to per-template `template.yaml`; structured examples dropped in favour of parsing `example.md`; init seed embedded in internal/scaffold (written once, never read by render paths); `default` remains the implicit theme name, resolved against the project.
